ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious IO.FileStream
ruleDefinitions.description: Open a handle on the drive volume via the \\.\ DOS device path specifier and perform direct access read of the first few bytes of the volume. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-Object.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*IO\\\.FileStream.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\\\\.\\\\.*"))
